headline: Pakistan's freelancer export earnings hit an all-time monthly high of US$210 million in October 2026, up 53 per cent year-on-year, and reached US$760 million in July-October FY27, up 47 per cent, Finance Minister's Advisor Khurram Schehzad said, APP reports.

card.desc: July se October tak kamai $760 million, 47 feesad izafa

caption:
Pakistani freelancers ki record kamai, sirf October mein $210 million! 💻
APP ke mutabiq Finance Minister ke Advisor Khurram Schehzad ne Wednesday ko bataya ke October 2026 mein freelancers ki export kamai $210 million rahi. Yeh ab tak kisi bhi ek mahine ki sab se zyada kamai hai, aur pichle saal October ke muqable mein 53 feesad zyada hai. July se October tak freelancers ne $760 million kamaye, jabke pichle saal isi arse mein $515 million kamaye the, yaani 47 feesad izafa. Unhon ne kaha ke agar yehi raftar rahi to is saal kamai $2 billion se barh sakti hai.
Kya aap bhi freelancing karte hain? Comment mein batayein 👇
